version: v1.1 (2026-08-15; BAL policy corrected to the real-data analysis of record)

molly_matrix_of_record.miss_closure: det + subfloor_nhat + lowP + flag + unmatched == tot per cell
molly_matrix_of_record.covariance_companion: p1_ckm_cov_v1.npz (whole-healpix jackknife, nside 16 nested; p1_joint_cov machinery)

P1_PRIMARY_LYA.snr_field: SNR_REDSIDE = mean(flux*sqrt(ivar)) over unmasked rest-frame [1420,1480] A (dlasearch.py:670-676, constants.py:40-41); per-spectrum, DLA-uncorrelated red side
P1_PRIMARY_LYA.p_dla_field: P_DLA (posterior probability that the MAP absorber model is preferred; dlacat column)
P1_PRIMARY_LYA.bal_policy: REAL-DATA analysis of record (track_c_tf_loa staging + this work): drop TARGETIDs with BI_CIV>0 (v2-altbal catalogue; the staged bal_cat convention) + DLAFLAG POTENTIAL_BAL bit active via DLAFLAG==0. The Molly MOCK-eval drop-all-bal_cat convention applies to the truth-complete mock channel only. H2 canonical tables regenerated under BI_CIV>0 drop (15/179 armA, 31/360 armB sightlines).
P1_PRIMARY_LYA.lambda_rf_window: lya_only: lam_rf(Z_DLA) in [1025,1216] A via make_lambda_z_BAL_cuts (examples/molly_faithful_pc_plots.py:405): z_lo=max(3600/LYA-1, lam_min(1+zq)/LYA-1+collar), z_hi=min(zq-collar, lam_max(1+zq)/LYA-1-collar), collar=3000 km/s (z units), strict
P1_PRIMARY_LYA.lyb_veto: postprocess.lyb_veto.flag_lybeta (dz 0.005, higher-NHI parent required) - part of the bundle; STRUCTURALLY INERT under MAX_DLAS=1 single-row-per-sightline output (recorded, not dropped)

matcher.order: cat rows in DESCENDING NHI_pred (ratified 2026-05-19 order fix)
matcher.association: same TARGETID, |dz|/(1+z_truth) < 0.01, unmatched-truth pool, tie-break min |NHI_pred - NHI_truth|
matcher.cardinality: greedy 1-to-1; no merge/split; each truth matched at most once
matcher.multiple_injections: H2 sightlines carry <=2 injections; the same 1-to-1 matcher applies (both injections in the truth pool; single-absorber output can match at most one)

metrics.association_purity: N(selected detections matched to ANY valid truth in truth-complete support) / N(selected detections). Only defined on TRUTH-COMPLETE channels (mocks). NOT computable from H2 alone.
metrics.estimand_purity: for reporting domain T: N(selected detections with measured in T AND matched truth in true T) / N(selected detections with measured in T). Sub-threshold matched detections are UPWARD MIGRANTS, never forest FP.
metrics.detection_completeness: N(eligible truths with a selected valid match, ANY measured NHI) / N(eligible truths). Finder recovery.
metrics.reporting_completeness: for true domain T: N(eligible truths in true T whose selected valid match ALSO lands measured in T) / N(eligible truths in true T). Includes downward migration as reporting loss; the scalar most directly tied to a thresholded estimand.

response.primary_calibration_object: the full operator (truth bin i -> measured bin j) + MISS classes; scalars are projections, never replacements
response.orientation: K_id_grid[(snr_cell, truth_nhi_cell), moments]; C = det/tot per (snr, truth-NHI) cell; counts preserved (no silent renormalization; loader-enforced)
response.sub_floor_support: truth support to 17.2; latent/operator support NEVER truncated at reporting floor (ruling: broad latent support BINDING)

uncertainty.canonical: whole-healpix jackknife (nside 16 nested), the p1_joint_cov/p1_ckm_cov machinery - dependence unit = healpix (sightlines within a healpix and injections within a sightline are NOT IID)
uncertainty.h2_historical: row-level Jeffreys 68% intervals (h2_analyze.py) - PRESERVED with that label; canonical H2 uncertainties regenerated with parent-sightline grouping (cluster bootstrap over sightlines) and differences recorded

h2_non_injection_detections: a finder detection on an H2 real-spectrum substrate not matched to an injected truth is a NON-INJECTION DETECTION (the real spectrum may host a real absorber). NEVER counted as FP; excluded from purity claims; H2 informs completeness/response/migration/transport only. Forest-FP purity comes from the truth-complete Molly/mock channel (miss/unmatched classes + ff_fp products).
